app.name: Sourcebound
app.tagline: Courses where every sentence is bound to its source.

common.deniedBody: Your account does not have access to this part.
common.unsavedBody: You have edits that were not saved.
common.tagsHint: Optional, comma-separated. Empty means all courses. Example: nursing, hms
common.deniedHome: Go to the first page you can use

signin.title: Sign in
signin.body: Use your organisation account. Signing in does not grant any rights by itself.

waiting.title: Waiting for access
waiting.body: Your account is created, but it has no rights yet. An administrator has to grant a role before you can continue.

invite.title: Invitation
invite.signinBody: Sign in to accept this invitation. You will return here afterwards.
invite.scopes: You now have access to the course you were invited to.
invite.help: You were invited to a course. Accept the invitation to open it.
invite.noLanding: Your account has no page to open yet. Ask the person who invited you.

bell.title: Notifications
bell.empty: Nothing is running. Start a plan or generate a course and the job appears here.
bell.help: Long jobs such as writing a plan or generating a course are listed here while they run.

op.queuedToast: Queued. You will find it in the bell.
op.inBell: You will find it in the bell.

users.title: Users
users.name: Name
users.scope: Limit to courses with these labels
users.banBody: The account cannot sign in again and its sessions end.
users.deleteBody: This removes the personal data of {name} and cannot be undone.
users.heirHint: If this person owns courses or sources, choose who takes them over.
users.legacyOption: Keep a legacy holder that can never sign in
users.help: Everyone with an account, their roles and their status.
users.legacyHint: Choose this if nobody should take over the courses.
users.roleHint: The role decides which pages and actions the person gets.
users.unbanBody: {name} can sign in again. Their earlier sessions and invites stay revoked.
users.removeRoleBody: The person loses what this role allows, at once. The role itself stays.

roles.title: Roles
roles.name: Name
roles.deleteBody: Everyone who holds this role loses it. This cannot be undone.
roles.builtIn: The built-in administrator role is fixed.
roles.help: A role is a set of permissions. Assign it to people on the Users page.
roles.scopeHint: Optional. Limits the role to courses with these labels; empty means all courses. Example: nursing

courses.title: My courses
courses.empty: You have no courses yet. A course is built from approved sources, a plan and checked blocks.
courses.help: Every course you author, with the next step it needs.
courses.languageHint: The language learners read the course in.

invites.title: Invite links
invites.intro: An invite gives a learner the student role on one course. Pick the course, create the link and send it.
invites.maxUsesHint: Optional. Leave empty for unlimited, for example: 30
invites.expiresHint: Optional. Pick the last day the link works.
invites.linkOnce: The link of an invite is shown only when it is created; copy it now.
invites.courseHint: The invite opens this course for the learner. Example: Hand hygiene
invites.earlierHelp: Every invite you can see, with the course it opens.
invites.noneNew: No new link in this visit. Create an invite above.
invites.reloadToRevoke: Reload the page to revoke this one.
invites.revokeBody: The link stops working at once. People who already accepted keep their access.
invites.expiresPast: Pick today or a later day.

needs.unread: wait for the blocks to be read, or generate again

course.questionCount: {count} open questions | {count} open question | {count} open questions

help.sources: Add the sources the course may quote and approve each one before it is used.
help.plan: The outline the course will be written from. Open a topic to see its blocks.
help.fix: Blocks the checker held back, each with the reason and the source passage.
help.publish: Check the summary, publish, and share the course with learners.
help.generate: Writes every block from the plan and the approved sources. It runs in the background.

sources.addHint: Every block of the course will point back to a passage of an approved source.
sources.queuedForHuman: The site forbids automatic fetching. A person has to decide.
sources.empty: No sources yet. Every block of the course points back to a passage of an approved source, so start here.

passages.some: {n} passages read | {n} passage read | {n} passages read

sources.candidatesHelp: Read, but not used until you approve them.
sources.fileHint: PDF, Markdown, plain text, an image or audio. Example: hygiene-guide.pdf
sources.fromAddressHelp: The page is fetched and read. A site that forbids this waits for a person.
sources.fromFileHelp: The kind is detected from the file name; change it if it is wrong.
sources.mediaHint: Audio is turned into text after upload; its state shows in the list.
sources.noCandidates: Nothing is waiting for your approval.
sources.waitingAddressesHelp: These sites forbid automatic fetching. Approve to read them anyway, or dismiss.
sources.thinReason: This address gave no readable text. Paste or upload its content instead.

plan.deleteBody: {name} and everything under it will be removed from the plan. This cannot be undone.
plan.before: Before the course can be written
plan.answerHint: Saved with the plan as soon as you press Save answer.
plan.methodologyHint: Pick one or more. You can combine methods that fit together.
plan.queries: What to look for in the sources
plan.queriesHint: One search per line. Example: hand hygiene steps
plan.stoppedHelp: The last plan build stopped before writing a plan. Build again, or answer the open questions below first.
plan.buildStopped: The last plan build stopped before writing a plan.
plan.alreadyQueued: Already queued; wait for it to finish.
plan.beforeHelp: Questions the course needs answered before it can be written. Each card saves on its own.
plan.blocksHelp: The pieces this topic will be written as, each tied to its source passages.
plan.buildHelp: Choose how the course teaches and what to look for in the sources; the outline is written for you.
plan.objectivesHelp: What a learner can do after this topic.
plan.pickMethodology: Choose at least one method first.
plan.purposeHelp: Why this module exists and which topics it holds.
plan.typeQueries: Write at least one thing to look for.
plan.addSourceFirst: Add and approve a source first
plan.regenerateBody: The course was generated already. Every block of the plan is written and checked again, which costs about {cost}. To change one block only, rewrite it on the What to fix page.
plan.buildCard: Build the plan from your sources
plan.outlineHelp: Titles save when you leave the field. Open a topic to see its blocks.
plan.nextHelp: Write every block of this outline on the Generate page.
plan.topicToggle: Show or hide the blocks of {name}
plan.emptyTopic: This topic has no blocks yet. Write a brief or delete it.
plan.treeInvalid: The plan has errors. Fix or delete the marked topics first.
plan.conflictBody: Someone changed this plan while you were editing. Reload their version, or keep yours and overwrite it.
plan.leftOutHelp: What the approved sources contain that this course does not teach, and why the planner left it out.

run.title: Generation run
run.empty: This run has nothing to show.
run.resumeHint: Resume continues from the last good step; nothing paid is paid again.
run.noTopics: This course has no topics yet.
run.cancelOnlyRunning: Only a running run can be cancelled.
run.heldHelp: Each links to the block and its reason.
run.help: What the generation is doing now, what it has cost, and where it needs you.
run.resumeOnlyStopped: Only a stopped run can be resumed.
run.stepsHelp: Each step writes or checks one block.
run.cancelBody: Blocks already written are kept. You can resume the run later.

fix.title: What to fix
fix.empty: Nothing is held back. Every generated block passed its checks.

done.batch: Rewrite of all held blocks queued.
done.recheck: Re-check done: {released} released, {unread} back to draft for a reading, {held} still held.

fix.noPassage: The source passage is not available.
fix.editHint: Describe what the block should say; do not paste the answer into the question.
fix.help: Each row is a block the checker held back. Rewrite it, edit its brief, or accept it after you checked it.
fix.notGenerated: Nothing to fix yet: generate the course first.
fix.typeBrief: Write the brief to save it.
fix.unread: Nothing is held, but {count} are still waiting to be read. Generate again to finish them.

publish.title: Publish
publish.reviewVisible: Learners with an invite will see this version.
publish.published: Published. Learners with an invite see this version.
publish.help: Publishing freezes a version that invited learners will see.
publish.shareHelp: A student link opens the course to anyone who signs in with it. Seats and expiry are set on the Invites page.
publish.shareLink: Create an invite link for this course
publish.summaryHelp: What you are about to publish.
publish.unread: {count} are written but not read yet.
publish.unreadFirst: {count} are not read yet. Finish the generation first.
publish.translationsKept: Existing translations ({languages}) are carried over: every block whose source text did not change keeps its translation.
publish.translationHeld: Translation {language}: {held} held and {failed} failed blocks. They stay as they are until you translate again.
publish.publicHelp: A public course is open to every signed-in user, without an invite. Learners read, answer and ask the tutor on your key.
publish.publicLabel: Public: every signed-in user can take this course
publish.publicFirst: Publish the course first; only a published course can be public.
publish.publicOff: The course is no longer public.

count.question: {count} open questions | {count} open question | {count} open questions

merrill_first_principles.line: Start from a real case, show, let learners apply, then integrate.

backward_design.name: Backward design
backward_design.line: Outcomes first, then evidence, then the learning plan.

kolb_experiential.name: Kolb experiential learning
kolb_experiential.line: Experience, reflect, form concepts, try it out.

confirm.typeHint: The name must match exactly. This cannot be undone.

shortcuts.title: Keyboard shortcuts
shortcuts.help: Shortcuts work when you are not typing in a field.

scope.coursesHelp: Choose existing courses. Leave empty for the whole school.
scope.labelsLabel: Limit to courses with these labels
scope.labelsHelp: Choose existing labels. Empty means all courses.
scope.empty: No courses or labels exist yet.
scope.loadError: The list of courses could not be loaded: {message}

translate.title: Translate
translate.help: Write the course in other languages. Blocks that fail the checks stay held and learners see the source text with a notice.
translate.noVersion: Publish the course first, then translate it.
translate.alreadyQueued: A translation is already queued; wait for it to finish.

preview.title: Preview as learner
preview.help: The course as a learner will read it: modules, topics and blocks, with held blocks marked.
preview.empty: This course has no written blocks yet.
preview.heldNote: {n} blocks are still held; publishing waits for them. | {n} block is still held; publishing waits for it. | {n} blocks are still held; publishing waits for them.
preview.readyNote: Every block is accepted. The course reads as the learner will see it.

learn.lastLesson: That was the last lesson of the course.
learn.title: My learning
learn.help: The courses you are enrolled in and the public courses, with your progress.
learn.empty: You are not enrolled in a published course yet. Ask your teacher for an invite link.
learn.noTopics: The course has no topics yet.
learn.spotWhich: Which sentence does not match the sources?
learn.spotKind: What kind of error is it?
learn.spotPassage: Which passage shows the true statement?
learn.spotFixHelp: Write the wording the source supports.

result.noneWrong: No sentence was wrong in this exercise.

counters.caption: Your find-the-error record by kind (hits / false alarms / misses)

learn.answerSomething: Answer at least one question first.

companion.title: Source
companion.hint: Select a citation to read the source passage here.

tutor.title: Ask about the materials
tutor.help: Answers are quotes from this course sources, never free text. If the sources do not say it, you are told so.
tutor.question: Your question
tutor.questionHelp: Up to 2000 characters. Example: How long must hands be rubbed?
tutor.notInMaterials: This is not in the course materials.

learn.orderHelp: Move each step until the list runs in the order the source states.

flashcards.title: Review the terms
flashcards.help: Say the definition, then turn the card to compare with the sentence the reading used.

learn.diagramFallback: The diagram could not be drawn; the steps are listed in order instead.

runs.title: Runs
runs.help: Every generation, translation and rewrite run of this course, newest first.
runs.empty: No run yet. Generate the course from the Plan page.

learnCourse.outcomes: What you will be able to do
learnCourse.title: Course outline
learnCourse.help: Modules and topics with your progress. Pick a topic or continue where you left off.
learnCourse.empty: This course has no topics to read yet.
learnCourse.languageHelp: The language you read in. Blocks not yet translated show the source text with a notice.
learnCourse.notPublished: This course is not published, or you are not enrolled in it. An author reads an unpublished course in its preview.
learnCourse.glossaryLink: {n} terms in the glossary | {n} term in the glossary | {n} terms in the glossary

learnTopic.title: Topic
learnTopic.help: Read the blocks, open a source beside the text, and check your answers. Attempts never lock.
learnTopic.lessonHelp: Read each block and check your answers as you go.
learnTopic.testHelp: Answer what you can, then submit the whole page. You can retake the test.
learnTopic.empty: This topic has no content to read yet.
learnTopic.unanswered: {count} questions unanswered | {count} question unanswered | {count} questions unanswered

report.title: Learner report
report.help: Completion, scores and find-the-error results for each enrolled learner.
report.notPublished: The course is not published yet, so no learner can work on it.
report.empty: No learner is enrolled yet. Create an invite to add the first one.
report.courseErrorsHelp: Hits, false alarms and misses by error kind across all learners.

generate.noPlanHelp: The course is written from the plan, so the outline comes first.
generate.goQuestions: Answer the questions on the Plan page
generate.runHelp: The current or last time the course was written.
generate.approveSources: Approve at least one source first

previewTopic.title: Preview a topic
previewTopic.help: The topic as a learner reads it. Answers are not recorded here.
previewTopic.empty: This topic has no written blocks yet.
previewTopic.heldNote: {n} blocks of this topic are held; the reason stands above each. | {n} block of this topic is held; the reason stands above it. | {n} blocks of this topic are held; the reason stands above each.

learnSources.title: Sources
learnSources.help: Every source this course was written from, under the number its citations carry in the text.
learnSources.empty: This course has no approved source yet.

glossary.title: Glossary
glossary.help: The terms this course introduces, each with the sentence that introduces it and the topic where it first appears.
glossary.empty: This course introduces no terms yet.
glossary.noDefinition: Named in the plan, not yet in the reading.

account.title: Account
account.help: Your sign-in and the Meta API key your course runs are billed to.
account.keyWhy: Planning, generating, translating and the tutor on your courses call the Meta Model API with this key. Without it those actions stay off.
account.keySet: A key is on file, ending in …{hint}.
account.keyReplace: New key (replaces the one on file)
account.keyHelp: Paste the key from your Meta developer dashboard. It is stored encrypted and never shown again.
account.keyRemoveBody: Runs you start afterwards are refused until you add a key again.
account.keyPrivacy: The key is encrypted at rest with a server secret, never logged and never returned by any request.
account.noKey: Add your Meta API key on your account page first.
account.keyFallback: On this machine the server key is used until you add your own.
account.leadsHelp: What is paid from it and where it comes from.
account.leadsBilled: Every plan, generation, translation and rewrite you start is paid from this key, pay as you go, at the Meta Model API prices.
account.leadsTutor: Learners on your published courses ask the tutor on your key as well.
account.leadsGet: Get or renew the key in the Meta developer dashboard

calls.title: Model calls
calls.help: Every call this run made to the Meta Model API: which model, which step, tokens, cost and time. Open a call to read its request and reply.
calls.helpCompact: What this run has asked the Meta Model API so far, by step.
calls.empty: No model calls recorded for this run yet.
calls.none: This run has not called a model yet.
calls.openRun: Open the run to see every call
calls.drawerHelp: Exactly what was sent to {model} and what came back. Keys and learner data are never stored here.
calls.noReply: No reply stored for this call.

build.title: Build the whole course
build.help: One click: the plan, the writing and one rewrite of held blocks run by themselves, within the cap you set. Publishing stays your decision.
build.capHint: The build stops by itself when it has spent this much. A stopped build continues where it left off.
build.forecastLater: The forecast appears once the plan is built.
build.forecast: Forecast for the plan: {cost}. A forecast, not a limit; only the cap stops the build.
build.crashNote: If the worker stops in the middle of a call, that one step may be paid twice.
build.stopBody: The current run stops after the call in flight. Blocks already written are kept and you can continue later.
build.stopWait: There is no run to stop right now; the next stage is starting.
build.stoppedCap: Build stopped: the spending cap was reached
build.stoppedHelp: Everything paid so far is kept. Continue picks up at the first unfinished step.
build.readyHeld: {count} blocks are held for your review.
build.assumedHelp: The plan follows the sources and the profile as they stand. Answer on the plan page and rebuild to change it.
build.unknown: Build status could not be loaded
